en.headline: Customs seize 6.4 kg of ketamine; two secondary students arrested
en.dek: The drugs were hidden inside garden lamp posts in an air parcel from Belgium; the 13- and 14-year-old boys were due to start Secondary Two on Tuesday.
body: Customs officers seized about 6.4 kilograms of suspected ketamine with an estimated street value of about HK$2.6 million from an air parcel from Belgium, and arrested two secondary-school boys who collected the package.

The parcel, declared as garden lamp posts, was intercepted at Hong Kong International Airport on 27 August. Officers found the drugs concealed inside 17 lamp posts after X-ray examination showed anomalies.

On Monday afternoon, under a controlled-delivery operation, the package was originally destined for a public-housing unit in Kwai Chung but the delivery point was changed nearby. Two boys, aged 13 and 14 and friends with each other, collected the parcel and were arrested in Ngau Tau Kok. They were due to begin Secondary Two on Tuesday.

Customs said one boy was promised HK$2,000 while the other did not know the amount. Both will face a charge of trafficking in a dangerous drug and are due to appear at Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday. The investigation continues.

zh.headline: 海關檢6.4公斤氯胺酮 拘兩名中二生
zh.dek: 毒品藏於比利時空運園林燈柱包裹內；13歲及14歲男童原定周二開學升讀中二。
body: 海關在一件由比利時寄港的空運包裹內檢獲約6.4公斤懷疑氯胺酮，市值約260萬元，並拘捕兩名負責收取包裹的中學生。
該包裹報稱為園林燈柱，於8月27日在香港國際機場被截查。關員以X光檢查發現異常影像，其後在17支燈柱內發現毒品。
周一午，海關展開監控遞送行動，包裹原送往葵涌一個公屋單位，其後改為附近地點。兩名分別13歲及14歲、互相為朋友的男童現身收取包裹，其後在牛頭角被拘捕。兩人原定周二開學升讀中二。
海關表示，其中一名男童獲許2,000元報酬，另一名則不清楚金額。兩人將被暫控販運危險藥物罪，案件周三在九龍城裁判法院提堂。調查仍在進行。
